name: pnx-context
description: A sidebar pane showing which PlatformNEX component the repo you are in belongs to: health, open pull requests, open releases and small graphs. Read-only except one button that opens a draft release (never deploys). Opt-in; needs a personal PlatformNEX API key.

baseUrl.title: PlatformNEX URL
baseUrl.description: The PlatformNEX portal address (https only, no trailing slash). The default is the one most people want; change it only to use another environment.

apiKey.title: PlatformNEX API key
apiKey.description: A personal key that starts with pnx_. Create it in the portal (user menu, API keys). It acts as you, so never paste it into chat or a file. Run /pnx-context setup in Claude Code for the exact command to save it.
